knight.name: Knight
knight.active: Once per round: +3 to the selected card, free.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.passive: First ±1 tweak on a club is free.
ranger.active: Once per round: your next trail space ignores the rising rule.

druid.name: Druid
druid.passive: Swapping a card between ♣ and ♥ is free.
druid.active: Once per round: heal 2 and gain 1 mana.

bard.name: Bard
bard.active: Once per round: a soothing song — reduce Threat by 2.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.active: Once per round: flip your hero deck’s top card — number: gain half its value in mana (rounded up); face: fizzle, gain 1 gold.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.passive: Wounds cost you only 1 point instead of 2.
necromancer.active: Once per round: blood magic — take 1 wound, gain 3 mana.
